scenes.text: The landlord said the spare room had not been opened in years.
scenes.art_prompt: a narrow closed door at the end of a dim hallway, warm lamp light, quiet dread

scenes.text: But every morning, the key was warm.
scenes.art_prompt: a single brass key on a small table, faint heat haze, dark room, unsettling

scenes.text: I pressed my ear to the wood and heard someone breathing in time with me.
scenes.art_prompt: a person kneeling with an ear to a closed door, long shadows, tense

scenes.text: So I stopped breathing, and listened for it to stop too.
scenes.art_prompt: a still figure in a dark hallway holding its breath, candle glow, fear

scenes.text:
It did not stop.
It had been matching me so I would not notice it was always one breath ahead.
scenes.art_prompt: a door cracked slightly open with darkness beyond, warm light leaking, horror

scenes.text: Follow Quiet Horror Files for the next case.
scenes.art_prompt: a dim empty hallway with one closed door, fading lamp light, quiet and final
